status: The reviewer findings on the native Commerce save are closed on the pushed tree: replay happens before semantic validation, Finance Money is written and retained before the party/price/version guards, the owner CAS enforces version/draft state, Sales selected pricing and Finance party/Money witnesses are retained across deferred constraints, and conversion validates Money before the stale guard but inserts it after the quote update and before the sales row. sales/quotes returns to verified; sales/orders, fulfillment, cancellations and revenue handoff remain open.

saveOrder.order: actor/module admission -> command lock/digest/replay -> semantic validation -> current IAM -> setup currency -> existing order read -> party/warehouse/product/price-list reads and amount calculation -> Finance Money INSERT retained + Finance party assertion + Sales selected-pricing/price guard -> owner update/insert CAS on expected version and draft state -> lines -> receipt/audit/outbox -> SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE -> Finance/Sales witness revalidation.
saveOrder.replay: An exact retry returns the original receipt before semantic validation, source reads or Finance work. The selected-route suite replays a saved create and a conversion while a conflicting Money table lock is held and still receives 200 with the original receipt.
saveOrder.moneyBeforeGuards: Native save writes the 1+3N order-revision Money rows before the party/version assertions. A stale version with an already-written revision fails on the duplicate Money key as generic CONFLICT; a foreign party returns generic CONFLICT; foreign product/price list remain 422 before Money.
saveOrder.witnesses: The Finance party guard uses the exact active customer/company/currency predicate (personal parties excluded), the Sales selected-pricing witness captures the exact list and bounded items, and the Sales price guard asserts active/company/version/date after Money. All three plus the retained Money quote/rows are revalidated after deferred constraints.
saveOrder.legacyRetirement: The Next Commerce route selects the native save for quotation/sales drafts once configured and surfaces a native failure instead of falling back; purchase/request handoffs remain retained and explicitly fall back only outside the workflow.

conversion.preflight: Money quote/scale/rate/amount validation runs before the stale-version guard, matching the original TS awaited commerceMoney preparation.
conversion.apply: The retained Money INSERT runs after the quote state update and before the new sales-order row and line copy; a stale conversion therefore returns generic CONFLICT before any Finance lock or write.
conversion.retention: The prepared quote is transaction-bound; the applied quote/rows are revalidated after deferred constraints. A preflight from a rolled-back transaction cannot be applied in a fresh one.
